items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Udell, no, I heard the name, I don't know him.

ctx.x: Do you know Udell Wilson, did you ever know him? No. I think he's from Kansas City and he played around.
Udell, no, I heard the name, I don't know him.
He worked with Louis on piano, so I'm Ian Zutty, working a trio, I just wondered, it might be the same. You can ask Louis. Yeah. What's the name, I heard that name?
